data.name: Menu.Tip.Graceful
data.value:
Applications that do not exit when prompted automatically get terminated by default to ensure a successful shutdown.
A graceful shutdown, on the other hand, will wait for all applications to exit before continuing with the shutdown. This might result in an unsuccessful shutdown if one or more applications are unresponsive or require a user interaction to exit.

data.name: Menu.Tip.PreventSleep
data.value: Depending on the power settings of your system, it might go to sleep after a certain amount of time due to inactivity. This option will keep the system awake to ensure the timer can properly run and execute a shutdown.

data.name: Menu.Tip.RunInBackground
data.value: This will launch the countdown without a visible window but will show a tray icon in your taskbar.

data.name: Menu.Tip.CountdownMode
data.value: Will count down from the hours, minutes and seconds selected below, like a countdown timer, and execute the power action when it reaches zero.

data.name: Menu.Tip.TimeOfDayMode
data.value:
In this mode you can select the target time of day (24h clock) for the power action. If the time has already passed, it will roll over to tomorrow.
When you press start, the appropriate countdown will be calculated.

data.name: Settings.AboutText
data.value:
This app is a free open-source project by Lukas Langrock under the MIT license which means there is no warranty provided and I shall not be held liable for any kind of damage! After all you may lose unsaved work or mess up another running application. Use this with caution and common sense!
The application is built to be reliable and should accurately measure and count time. I can't exactly guarantee this but I aim to get the application to be as stable and polished as possible. In the case you encounter an error or notice the application not working as it should, an issue on GitHub or an Email would be very appreciated so I can fix the mistake.
If you enjoy using this free app, please consider writing a review on the Microsoft Store or starring the project on GitHub. Any contributions in the form of issues and PR's are very welcome.
